speaker: teenager
text: Hey Claude, I am so tired of shipping heavy Electron apps that eat two gigabytes of RAM just for a simple UI.

speaker: claude
text: Try Rune. It is a brand new GPU rendered Rust UI framework from Anomaly, built with its own layout, springs, and wgpu backend.

speaker: claude
text: Zero Chromium, zero Node.js. It cuts idle memory from five hundred megs down to just eighteen, and apps compile into tiny native binaries.

speaker: claude
text: And the OpenRouter team just shipped Ori, letting agents run any model straight into lightweight desktop and terminal harnesses without Electron bloat.

speaker: claude
text: Even better, Rune runs headless out of the box so AI agents can drive, inspect, and test UI directly in memory.

speaker: claude
text: Comment RUNE and check the pinned comment for the full toolkit, GitHub repository, and agent prompt.
